memory-store.memory.context.description: Load the memory records relevant to an identity, kinds and the resolved project selection: each record's identity, kind and scope decide, never where the backend keeps it. One bounded page in kind-then-id order; freshness says when each record changed and when it was read. The binding's settings choose the backend: a store directory (file) or a branch of a Git repository (git). Only the git backend with a remote reaches the network.

inputSchema.description: The memory.context request document of go.putnami.dev/protocol/collaboration version 1.

memory-store.memory.mission.description: Read one mission's checkpointed record with its revision, provenance and freshness. The binding's settings choose the backend: a store directory (file) or a branch of a Git repository (git). Only the git backend with a remote reaches the network.

inputSchema.description: The memory.mission request document of go.putnami.dev/protocol/collaboration version 1.

memory-store.memory.checkpoint.description: Save a mission checkpoint against its expected revision, or create the mission with mustNotExist. The comparison and the write are one step (under the store lock for file, a conditional ref update or a leased push for git), so of two writers at one revision exactly one lands and the other gets a conflict. A repeated idempotency key replays the write it produced. A push whose outcome is unknown is reconciled by reading the branch again; when that fails the checkpoint is unresolved. Evidence entries are references: this provider never records that anything passed. The binding's settings choose the backend: a store directory (file) or a branch of a Git repository (git). Only the git backend with a remote reaches the network.

inputSchema.description: The memory.checkpoint request document of go.putnami.dev/protocol/collaboration version 1.

memory-store.memory.search.description: Find memory records whose title or content contains the query, ignoring case, under the same selection as context. One bounded page in kind-then-id order; no index is kept. The binding's settings choose the backend: a store directory (file) or a branch of a Git repository (git). Only the git backend with a remote reaches the network.

inputSchema.description: The memory.search request document of go.putnami.dev/protocol/collaboration version 1.
